process: the monarchy is hereditary; governor appointed by the monarch; following legislative elections, the governor appoints the leader of the majority party or majority coalition as premier
governmentType: parliamentary democracy; self-governing overseas territory of the UK
cabinet: Cabinet selected from the Parliament and appointed by the governor on the advice of the premier
